title: PONG PING
models: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1) wrote the code, the assets and the critiques
Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) built the four halls, the rally music, the pencil mode, match point and the match report
no image or sound generator: every sound is synthesised at runtime from the physics
what_i_found: The rally is the music: every contact plays a note that climbs a pentatonic scale over a beat locked to the rally's own tempo, and past a dozen shots the whole hall redraws itself in pencil on paper while only the table, the ball and the two blades keep their colour. Underneath is a real racket, not a bat: a 2.7 g ball with drag and Magnus lift meets rubber modelled as grip and slip, so a flick or a sweep of the mouse is spin you can watch curve, and every level meets a nearly-right stroke halfway. Four opponents play in four halls, a school gym, a community hall, a club and an arena, all re-dressed from one kit of Three.js code, and every sound, from the knock of the ball to the crowd, is synthesised from the physics as it happens.
